title: 数据流动、数据价值实现与福利效应
title_zh: 数据流动、数据价值实现与福利效应
title_primary: 数据流动、数据价值实现与福利效应
official: 官方发布 2026-07-10 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: 数据流动是数字经济的核心特征之一，厘清数据流动过程中数据价值的实现机制及其对数据产业发展的影响，对中国布局未来数字产业和培育新质生产力具有重要意义。本文通过构建一个多部门数据跨区域流动的一般均衡模型，探究数据跨区域流动在数据价值实现过程中的核心机制作用，揭示其引致要素相对价格变动与福利水平提升的传导路径。研究发现：（1）数据跨区域流动主要通过生产率赋能效应、数据规模效应和结构转型效应影响数据产业发展，其作用方向取决于数据部门间的产品替代弹性和要素产出弹性。（2）随着数据共享规模扩大，数据流入地区生产率水平显著提升，数据要素在价值实现过程中的相对价格下降，数据经济价值得到进一步释放，有助于提升数据产业福利水平。（3）随着数据交易规模扩大，数据传输成本对部门间配置结构的影响趋于一致，生产率赋能效应相对弱化；尽管结构转型可能推高数据提炼溢价，但需求驱动型数据规模效应的作用更为显著，最终降低数据提炼溢价，提升数据产业福利水平。研究表明，随着数据要素流通属性的不断增强，促进数据自由流动有助于释放数据价值，并为数据要素市场的高质量发展注入新动能。

title: Dollar Asset Holdings and Hedging around the Globe

title_primary: 全球美元资产持有与对冲
title_secondary: Dollar Asset Holdings and Hedging around the Globe
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We collect and analyze detailed filings from global institutional investors to estimate foreign investors’ U.S. dollar (USD) security holdings and currency hedging. Over two decades, foreign USD holdings grew sixfold, while hedge ratios rose by 15 percentage points after the 2008–2009 crisis. Currency hedging across mutual funds, pensions, and insurance reached $2 trillion by 2019. Hedging demand varies across investors, currency areas, and banking systems. We show that expected FX returns, beyond variance minimization, drive currency exposure in portfolios. Finally, we demonstrate and quantify how aggregate hedging demand affects hedging costs in the presence of constrained intermediaries. (JEL F21, F31, G11, G15, G22, G23)
abstract_zh: 我们收集并分析了全球机构投资者的详细申报文件，以估算外国投资者的美元证券持有量及货币对冲情况。在二十年间，外国美元持有量增长了六倍，而2008-2009年危机后对冲比率上升了15个百分点。截至2019年，共同基金、养老金和保险公司的货币对冲规模达到2万亿美元。对冲需求因投资者、货币区域和银行体系的不同而存在差异。我们证明，除方差最小化外，预期外汇回报率也驱动着投资组合中的货币敞口。最后，我们展示并量化了在存在受限中介机构的情况下，总对冲需求如何影响对冲成本。（JEL F21, F31, G11, G15, G22, G23）

title: The Effect of Low-Skill Immigration Restrictions on US Firms and Workers: Evidence from a Randomized Lottery

title_primary: 低技能移民限制对美国企业与工人的影响：来自随机抽签的证据
title_secondary: The Effect of Low-Skill Immigration Restrictions on US Firms and Workers: Evidence from a Randomized Lottery
authors: Michael A. Clemens, Ethan G. Lewis
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: US firms hiring foreign workers in low-skill nonfarm jobs face a binding quota on the “H-2B” visa, allocated in part through a randomized lottery. We evaluate the quota’s marginal impact using the lottery, a novel firm survey, and a pre-analysis plan. Firms exogenously employing more H-2B workers in low-skill jobs increase production (elasticity 0.20–0.22), investment (1.5–2.1), and profits (0.15). The elasticity of substitution between H-2B and US workers is very low (0.8–2.2). Thus, the effect on US employment is zero or positive overall, and positive in rural areas. Forensic analysis suggests similarly low substitutability of black-market labor. (JEL J15, J24, J46, J61, J82, K37)
abstract_zh: 美国企业在低技能非农岗位雇佣外籍工人时，面临“H-2B”签证的约束性配额，该配额部分通过随机抽签分配。我们利用抽签机制、一项新颖的企业调查以及预分析计划，评估了该配额的边际影响。在低技能岗位中因外生因素雇佣更多H-2B工人的企业，其产量（弹性0.20–0.22）、投资（1.5–2.1）和利润（0.15）均有所提升。H-2B工人与美国工人之间的替代弹性极低（0.8–2.2）。因此，该配额对美国就业的整体影响为零或为正，且在乡村地区呈现正向效应。法证分析表明，黑市劳动力的可替代性同样较低。（JEL J15, J24, J46, J61, J82, K37）

authors: Michele Modugno, Dino Palazzo, Carlos A. Ramírez, Thiago R.T. Ferreira
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a market-based measure of firms' and industries' exposure to foreign trade disruptions. Combining this approach with detailed supervisory data, we quantify large U.S. banks' exposure to such disruptions and propose a novel bank-level vulnerability index. We show that banks with greater exposure experienced significantly larger stock price declines following the April 2025 tariff announcements. Our vulnerability index explains 18% of the cross-sectional variation in bank returns during this episode. _On February 27, 2026, the FEDS Paper was updated to correct misnumbered footnotes, remove an extraneous sentence from the abstract, add missing citations, and revise the conclusion._
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一种基于市场的企业及行业对外贸易中断风险敞口度量方法。结合详尽的监管数据，我们量化了美国大型银行对此类风险的敞口程度，并提出了一种新颖的银行层面脆弱性指数。研究表明，在2025年4月关税政策宣布后，风险敞口较大的银行股价跌幅显著更大。该脆弱性指数可解释此轮银行股收益率截面差异的18%。

title: Air Pollution and Cognitive Performance Under Varying Task Complexity
title_zh: 不同任务复杂度下的空气污染与认知表现
title_primary: 不同任务复杂度下的空气污染与认知表现
title_secondary: Air Pollution and Cognitive Performance Under Varying Task Complexity
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how short-term variations in fine particulate matter (PM2.5) pollution affects cognitive performance across tasks of varying complexity. While prior work shows that pollution impairs performance in highly demanding cognitive settings, it remains unclear whether these effects extend to simpler tasks. We examine this question using data from official Rubik's Cube tournaments in the United States and India. Solving different cube sizes provides a natural proxy for task complexity, while solving time measures cognitive performance. To identify causal effects, we exploit exogenous variation in local PM2.5 generated by wind direction. We find that PM2.5 pollution has negligible effects on simple tasks but significantly slows performance on complex ones for tournaments in the United States. In India, where baseline PM2.5 levels are substantially higher, we find similar effect patterns but none of the effects are statistically significant. We show that this pattern is explained by diminishing marginal sensitivity to short-term PM2.5 shocks as baseline PM2.5 pollution levels increase. Our findings provide causal evidence that the cognitive costs of PM2.5 pollution depend critically on task complexity.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染的短期波动如何影响不同复杂度任务中的认知表现。尽管已有研究表明污染会损害高认知需求环境下的表现，但尚不清楚这些影响是否延伸至简单任务。我们利用美国和印度官方魔方锦标赛的数据来探究这一问题。不同尺寸魔方的解法可作为任务复杂度的自然代理变量，而解题时间则衡量认知表现。为识别因果效应，我们利用风向引起的当地PM2.5外生变化。研究发现，PM2.5污染对美国锦标赛中简单任务的影响微乎其微，但显著降低了复杂任务的表现速度。在基线PM2.5水平显著更高的印度，我们观察到相似的影响模式，但所有效应均未达到统计显著性。我们证明，这一模式可通过短期PM2.5冲击的边际敏感性随基线PM2.5污染水平升高而递减来解释。研究结果提供了因果证据，表明PM2.5污染的认知成本关键取决于任务复杂度。

title_primary: 大规模质量调整：享乐指数与精确需求价格指数的比较

authors: Gabriel Ehrlich, John Haltiwanger, Ron Jarmin, David Johnson, Ed Olivares 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Item-level transactions data yield cost-of-living indices that can account for quality change and consumer substitution. Transactions data require confronting the rapid turnover of items because prices of new and existing products are interrelated in equilibrium. This paper evaluates multiple approaches to measuring quality change at scale. It shows that a hedonic superlative approach—using econometrics or machine learning for hedonic estimation combined with index formulas that require simultaneous observation of item-level price and expenditure—yields improved measures of the cost of living. Accounting for ubiquitous quality change and for consumer substitution yields lower measures of inflation than traditional, official methods. (JEL C43, C45, E31, L15, L81)
abstract_zh: 基于项目级交易数据编制的居民消费价格指数，能够反映质量变化与消费者替代行为。由于均衡状态下新旧产品价格相互关联，交易数据需应对项目快速更替的挑战。本文评估了多种大规模质量变化测算方法，研究表明：采用计量经济学或机器学习进行特征价格估计，并结合需同步观测项目级价格与支出的指数公式，所构建的特征价格超优指数能更精准地衡量生活成本。相较于传统官方统计方法，将普遍存在的质量变化与消费者替代行为纳入考量后，通胀测算结果显著降低。（JEL分类号：C43, C45, E31, L15, L81）

title: Trained to reduce food waste: Evidence from an RCT with micro-sized and small enterprises in Cusco's hospitality industry
title_zh: 减少食物浪费培训：库斯科酒店业微型和小型企业随机对照试验的证据
title_primary: 减少食物浪费培训：库斯科酒店业微型和小型企业随机对照试验的证据
title_secondary: Trained to reduce food waste: Evidence from an RCT with micro-sized and small enterprises in Cusco's hospitality industry
authors: Cesar E. Del Pozo Loayza, José D. López-Rivas, Francisco Alpízar
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Food waste from restaurants contributes to greenhouse gas emissions and puts pressure on urban waste systems, especially in low and middle-income countries. We conducted a randomized controlled trial to assess whether food waste management training reduces kitchen-level organic waste in micro-sized and small restaurants in the hospitality industry in Cusco, Peru, a major global tourist destination. We find that the intervention reduces food waste generation by 10 percent in the trained restaurants. We also find that it improved the staff’s knowledge and awareness of food waste management practices. A simple cost-benefit analysis suggests that skills-building interventions can improve the pro-environmental performance of micro and small firms and can be implemented with a positive net benefit to society.
abstract_zh: 餐厅产生的食物浪费加剧了温室气体排放，并对城市废弃物系统造成压力，尤其是在中低收入国家。我们在秘鲁库斯科——一个全球重要的旅游目的地——开展了一项随机对照试验，以评估食物浪费管理培训是否能减少酒店业中微型和小型餐厅的厨房有机废弃物。我们发现，该干预措施使受训餐厅的食物浪费产生量减少了10%。同时，干预还提升了员工对食物浪费管理实践的知识和意识。一项简单的成本效益分析表明，技能建设干预能够改善微型和小型企业的环境友好表现，并可为社会带来正净效益。
